summary_en: 26,250,100 shares to be cancelled (0.97% of shares outstanding). Effective date 2026-08-31. Shares acquired via board resolution of 2026-05-13. Post-cancellation issued share count: 2,693,184,033.
title_en: Notice of Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-07, Mitsui Fudosan's board of directors resolved under the Companies Act to cancel 26,250,100 treasury shares, effective 2026-08-31. These shares represent 0.97% of shares outstanding (computed as 26,250,100 ÷ 2,719,434,133 ex-treasury shares). The shares were acquired by board resolution on 2026-05-13. After cancellation, issued share count will be 2,693,184,033. No purchase price or acquisition cost is disclosed in the filing.
